---
title: "Showing US Data with Maps"
format: html
---

```{r}
#| message: false
#| warning: false

# Packages Required
library(tidyverse)
library(maps)
library(viridis)
library(lubridate)
library(leaflet)
library(sf)
library(htmltools)
library(glue)
library(rvest)
library(polite)
library(htmltools)
```

```{r}
# Numerical Data: State Populations
state_pops <- read_csv("NST-EST2025-ALLDATA.csv")

# Tidying the Population Data and Making a Variable to Track Change in Population from 2020 to 2025
state_pops <- state_pops |>
  mutate(state = parse_number(STATE),
         pop_change = POPESTIMATE2025 - POPESTIMATE2020) |>
  filter(state > 0) |>
  rename(name = NAME) |>
  select(name, pop_change) |>
  filter(!name %in% c("District of Columbia", "Puerto Rico", "Alaska", "Hawaii")) |>
  mutate(name = str_to_lower(name))
```

```{r}
# Map Data
us_states <- map_data("state") |>
  rename(name = region) |>
  filter(name != "district of columbia")

# Merge state_pops and us_states
state_pops_map <- state_pops |>
  right_join(us_states, by = "name")
```

```{r}
# Static Numerical Plot
state_pops_map |>
  mutate(pop_change_groups = cut(
    pop_change,
    breaks = c(-Inf, -50000, 0, 100000, 250000, 500000, 750000, 1500000, Inf),
    labels = c("Loss > 50,000", "Loss 0 to 50,000", "Gain 0 to 100,000", "Gain 100,000 to 250,000", "Gain 250,000 to 500,000", "Gain 500,000 to 750,000", "Gain 750,000 to 1,500,000", "Gain > 1,500,000")
  )) |>
  ggplot(mapping = aes(x = long, y = lat, group = group)) + 
    geom_polygon(aes(fill = pop_change_groups), color = "black") +
    labs(fill = "Population change from 2020 to 2025") +
    coord_map() + 
    theme_void() +
    scale_fill_brewer(palette = "RdYlGn")
```

```{r}
# Interactive Numerical Plot
#| warning: false

states_sf <- 
  read_sf("https://rstudio.github.io/leaflet/json/us-states.geojson") |>
  select(name, geometry) |>
  mutate(name = str_to_lower(name)) |>
  filter(!name %in% c("alaska", "district of columbia", "hawaii", "puerto rico"))

state_pops_map <- state_pops_map |>
  right_join(states_sf, by = "name")

# Create our bins for population changes
# Assign the yellow-orange-red color palette
bins <- c(-Inf, -50000, 0, 100000, 250000, 500000, 750000, 1500000, Inf)
pal <- colorBin("RdYlGn", domain = state_pops_map$pop_change, bins = bins)

# Create labels that pop up when we hover over a state.  The labels must
#   be part of a list where each entry is tagged as HTML code.
state_pops_map <- state_pops_map |>
  mutate(labels = str_c(name, ": ", pop_change, " population change"))

labels <- lapply(state_pops_map$labels, HTML)

state_pops_map <- st_as_sf(state_pops_map)

leaflet(state_pops_map) |>
  setView(-96, 37.8, 4) |>
  addTiles() |>
  addPolygons(
    fillColor = ~pal(pop_change),
    weight = 2,
    opacity = 1,
    color = "white",
    dashArray = "3",
    fillOpacity = 0.7,
    highlightOptions = highlightOptions(
      weight = 5,
      color = "#666",
      dashArray = "",
      fillOpacity = 0.7,
      bringToFront = TRUE),
    label = labels,
    labelOptions = labelOptions(
      style = list("font-weight" = "normal", padding = "3px 8px"),
      textsize = "15px",
      direction = "auto")) |>
  addLegend(pal = pal, values = ~pop_change, opacity = 0.7, title = NULL,
    position = "bottomright")
```
